description: From the Ancient Agora, looking west, the roofed Doric Temple of Hephaestus stands on the low hill, and the Acropolis with its architectural light is on a different hill to the left. Low ruins and trees fill the open ground. The sky is clear, about 12.2°C. No floodlight schedule was found for the Agora, so Hephaestus is not lit by a lighting rig.

Technical: masters at exact 1920x1080 / 864x1080 (sweep-verified); on-image caption 'Ancient Agora, Athens', scenario '24 September 2026 · 05:53 Europe/Athens', AI disclosure and exact 'Jason D's Vision' signature legible on the bottom gradient.
